new_unit_entry.name: state-leaf-reads
new_unit_entry.scope: Original 27 state-event reader roots plus 2 called helpers: 472B,153 instructions,45 architectural regions. C11/C++17 preserve 438 non-control bytes and 10 typed branches/calls; static original-VA encoding reproduces all selected original bytes. Original AUIPC/GP reads, packed fields, two helper calls, 16B frame and RA save/restore retained. No memory ownership, physical field meaning, private ABI, MCU/ROM/IRQ or OTA proof; no target/model/ISA execution.
